subject: GitHub sign-in is off on preprod because the Cognito GitHub IdP points at the GitHub Actions OIDC issuer
activeForm: Deciding whether preprod offers GitHub sign-in and how Cognito would reach GitHub

origin.evidence: card 27, 2026-10-15: preprod GET /api/v2/auth/oauth/urls returns providers=[google]; infrastructure/terraform/preprod.tfvars:74-84 enables Google only and says GitHub's IdP is known-broken; infrastructure/terraform/modules/cognito/github.tf:15-32 sets oidc_issuer and jwks_uri to token.actions.githubusercontent.com

work_items: Card #28: decide whether preprod should offer GitHub sign-in; if yes, make the Cognito GitHub IdP reach GitHub's user OAuth rather than the Actions token issuer, and enable it

description:
Target: Customer Dashboard (Next.js/Amplify).

MEASURED. Preprod's sign-in page shows Google only, by configuration: preprod.tfvars:74-84 sets cognito_identity_providers = ["Google"] and warns not to add GitHub. modules/cognito/github.tf:15-32 declares GitHub as an OIDC provider whose oidc_issuer and jwks_uri are the GitHub Actions token service, which issues workflow tokens, not user identity; a GitHub OAuth App returns no OIDC id_token, so this IdP cannot sign a user in as written.

FIRST, AN OPERATOR CALL. Is GitHub sign-in wanted on preprod at all? A no closes this card (and the github.tf block becomes a cleanup question). A yes needs a GitHub OAuth App secret in preprod/sentiment-analyzer/github-oauth and a route from Cognito to GitHub that Cognito supports, which may be a new AWS resource (an OIDC shim) and so needs the operator before it is built.

TEST. frontend/tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts:24 already shows the GitHub button exactly when the API returns github, so enabling it needs no test change.
